[USER] The subject is about business systems and this is the background of the lesson.  
[USER] In order to develop a career in the working world, it's important to know how businesses operate.  
[USER] This unit focuses on business systems and analyses the smooth running of operations across different industries and businesses.  
[USER] Learners will:  
[USER] Understanding the protocols of systems in business settings  
[USER] Analyse different operational systems and their effectiveness on business  
[USER] Understand HR systems and their impact on a business, including tasks such as work appraisals, objective setting, operational planning, scheduling rotas, etc.  
[USER] Explore the key theory that underpins the subject of content writing and development  
[USER] Understand the history of social media  
[USER] Enabling learners to write compelling social media posts.  
[USER] Learning will be practical wherever possible. Much of it will take place by solving problems through designing systems.  
[USER] Part of the assessment process includes learners creating a group presentation to solve an issue within a business by creating a new system (Assessment 1).  
[USER] This will enable learners to show their understanding of reflection, evaluation, and creation skills.  
[USER] The other assessment (Assessment 2) will follow after the presentation, this will include a summary report and reflection on the presentation.  
[USER] These are the learning objectives:  
[USER] Understand what kinds of business systems exist across a range of sectors  
[USER] 1.1 Understand what is meant by a system  
[USER] 1.2 Describe different types of system used in business.  
[USER] Understand why systems are important and what can go wrong  
[USER] 2.1 Identify situations where a system might be useful  
[USER] 2.2 Explain how and why different systems fail.  
[USER] Be able to implement a system  
[USER] 3.1 Understand the basics of systems architecture  
[USER] 3.2 Develop systems of their own in particular scenarios.  
[USER] Be able to operate a standard HR system  
[USER] 4.1 Explore the case of systems in HR  
[USER] 4.2 Evaluate the different stakeholders and users in a HR system.  
[USER] These are the target audience:  
[USER] Business Administrator  
[USER] Receptionist  
[USER] Office Manager

[USER] - What are HR Systems?  
[USER] - Different Types of Systems in HR / Different stakeholders and users in a HR System
